text:
annie_k: Quick thread to capture SEO tasks for the spring launch (blog series + gated webinar). Priorities: redirect hygiene, concise schema for event + speakers, keyword-led meta drafts, internal anchor plan, and UTMs -> CRM mapping.
matt_d: I can take redirects and the rollout script. Key ask: keep UTM query params intact across 301/302 transitions.
sophia_l: I'll produce keyword map + two meta variations per post for headline A/B. Priorities: long-tail phrases around "inference throughput tuning" and "production LLM latency".
devon_r: GTM & CRM mapping I'll own. Proposed UTMs: utm_source=launch_blast|organic_social|partner, utm_medium=social|email, utm_campaign=spring_release_2026. Map to SFDC Campaign = "Spring Release 2026".
seo-bot: Pro tip: stage JSON-LD on staging with data-nosnippet meta to avoid premature indexing. Run a staging-only crawl before publish.
annie_k: Redirect examples (CSV sample) - we'll keep a small canonical mapping and a fallback rule for legacy slugs:
```
from,to,status
/old/llm-economics,/hub/spring/llm-economics,301
/posts/benchmarks-2019,/hub/spring/benchmarks,301
/signup,/events/spring-2026/register,302
```
matt_d: Rollout notes: deploy redirects in batches, run redirect-check (no chains), then canonical crawler. I'll include a note to preserve referrer/UTM params on register endpoint.
sophia_l: Meta + headline tests (examples):
H1-A: "Practical tips to cut LLM inference latency"
H1-B: "How we tuned throughput for production LLMs"
Meta example: "Benchmark-driven tactics to reduce inference latency and cost. Includes GPU batching patterns and rollouts."
devon_r: CRM mapping details: capture utm_*s + landing_path + webinar_id in hidden fields. Map webinar_id -> CampaignMember and landing_path -> Lead.SourceDetail. Also add rule to append original_utm if user re-visits before converting.
annie_k: Internal linking plan: add contextual anchors from docs/serving-runtime -> benchmarks + hub banner on product pages. Use natural anchor text for at most 2 links per page to avoid over-optimization. Target top 75 pages by sessions.
seo-bot: Also add FAQPage JSON-LD for the landing with 4 short Qs (pricing, deployment, security, data retention). Combine Event + FAQ JSON-LD blocks on the landing.
matt_d: Implementation detail: during promo, keep /signup -> register as 302 to preserve live promo analytics, then flip to 301 with an archive page after 14 days. Schedule a smoke test at flip.
sophia_l: I'll upload keyword spreadsheet + meta drafts by Tue noon. Will include title tag (<=60 chars) + meta desc (100-155 chars) and primary/secondary keywords.
devon_r: I'll post GTM QA checklist and SFDC field mapping tomorrow. Also plan a GTM preview test to verify utm capture and dataLayer push events (event: register_click, category: launch).
annie_k: Owners: redirects -> @matt_d, keywords + metas -> @sophia_l, UTMs & GTM -> @devon_r, internal links -> @annie_k, schema -> @annie_k. Publish owner = content-growth.
matt_d: I'll open a PR with redirect CSV + rollout SOP. ETA: Thu AM.
sophia_l: I'll drop the keyword map + 2 headline variants per page by Wed EOD.
devon_r: GTM + SFDC mapping doc coming tomorrow morning. Will include reconciliation steps for post-flip traffic.
seo-bot: Scheduled checks: staging crawl 2026-04-17T07:30Z; post-publish redirect audit 2026-04-23T09:00Z.
annie_k: Thanks team ":rocket:". Keep PR links and ticket numbers in this thread; short updates only.
